mapper.select: SELECT d.dt AS stat_date, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mem_member WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= d.dt AND create_time < DATE_ADD(d.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS new_members, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(expense_amount), 0) FROM fin_expense WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND del_flag = '0' AND expense_date >= d.dt AND expense_date < DATE_ADD(d.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS daily_expense, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sale_amount), 0) FROM fin_sale_record WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND del_flag = '0' AND sale_date >= d.dt AND sale_date < DATE_ADD(d.dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS daily_sale FROM ( SELECT DATE(DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL t.n DAY)) AS dt FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ) t WHERE DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL t.n DAY) < #{endDate} ) d ORDER BY d.dt
